title: Waterstone Financial Declares Regular Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: WAUWATOSA, Wis., Sept. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Board of Directors of Waterstone Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: WSBF) declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per common share. The dividend is payable on November 2, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 8, 2026.
